origins.section: 19.1. A Clearing Record Carries the Final Amount and the Approval It Completes
19.2. A Transaction Belongs to the Business Day That the Network's Cutover Gives It
19.4. The Receiver Compares Every Total, Because Equal Nets Can Hide Different Counts
19.5. Matching Puts Every Record in One Category, and Each Category Has an Owner

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-presentment-without-code: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-presentment-without-code: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-presentment-without-code: 19.1's run without field 38 shows the issuer posting the presented amount while the authorized hold stays until it lapses (ledger 362.00, available 242.00), so 1,000 - 352 - 400 = 248.00 follows.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-after-cutover: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-after-cutover: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-after-cutover: 19.2 says a message that crosses the cutover counts on its own day: an 0420 delivered after cutover carries the next day's DE 15, and both ends count the purchase on the first day and the reversal on the next.
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-code-2: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-code-2: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-code-2: 19.4 says no money moves with an 0510, neither side's totals are corrected, settlement pays by the network's records, and the 2 starts the search for the transactions.
recorded.prompt:q-chargeback-day: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chargeback-day: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chargeback-day: 19.5 says a chargeback debits the acquirer in the clearing and settlement of the day it arrives, not of the sale.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-presentment-without-code:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-presentment-without-code:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-presentment-without-code:a: 19.1 says that without field 38 the issuer can't tell which hold the record completes, so the hold stays; the page never offers matching by card and amount.
recorded.prompt:q-presentment-without-code:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-presentment-without-code:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-presentment-without-code:c: 19.1 posts the presented 138.00, not the authorized 120.00, and the hold is released only through the approval code, never replaced by the posting.
recorded.prompt:q-presentment-without-code:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-presentment-without-code:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-presentment-without-code:d: 19.1's run without field 38 still posts 'clearing 138.00'; the page says such a presentment may later be charged back as unauthorized, but not that the issuer refuses it.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-after-cutover:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-after-cutover:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-after-cutover:b: 19.2 says the late 0420 carries the next day's DE 15 and is counted on that day, not on the original's day.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-after-cutover:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-after-cutover:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-after-cutover:c: 19.3 says a reversal counts once, in the reversal fields, and the debit it reverses stays counted.
recorded.prompt:q-reversal-after-cutover:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reversal-after-cutover:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reversal-after-cutover:d: 19.3 says the debit stays counted, and its 'reversal subtracted' counter is answered out of balance (19.4).
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-code-2:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-code-2:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-code-2:a: 19.4 says settlement pays by the network's records and neither side's totals are corrected.
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-code-2:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-code-2:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-code-2:c: 19.4 says a 2 is no reason to reverse anything, since a reversal is for a request whose outcome is unknown (unit 4).
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-code-2:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-code-2:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-code-2:d: 19.4 says a 2 is no reason to send the 0500 again because a recount gives the same totals until a record changes; only an unanswered 0500 is resent.
recorded.prompt:q-chargeback-day:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chargeback-day:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chargeback-day:b: 19.5 says disputes arrive as new records on a later day and settle on the day they arrive, 'not of the sale'.
recorded.prompt:q-chargeback-day:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chargeback-day:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chargeback-day:c: 19.5 says the chargeback debits the acquirer in clearing and settlement; partly true that the merchant bears the loss in the end (19.1).
recorded.prompt:q-chargeback-day:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-chargeback-day:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-chargeback-day:d: 19.5 says the money moves on the day the chargeback arrives, which rules out the presentment's day; the ARN only names the presentment.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
